# Nagendra Global Innovations (NGI)

> Nagendra Global Innovations (NGI) is an independent Indian technology company based in Vizianagaram, Andhra Pradesh, founded and led by Mudunuru Avinash Varma (Founder and CEO). NGI builds practical software, AI-powered workflow tools and connected digital platforms, including FaculZo.

## Official web properties
- Company website: https://nagendraglobalinnovations.in/
- Founder profile (company site): https://nagendraglobalinnovations.in/mudunuru-avinash-varma.html
- Founder personal website: https://avinashmudunuru.in/
- Product, FaculZo: https://faculzo.nagendraglobalinnovations.in/
- Contact: ceo@nagendraglobalinnovations.in

## Registration
- Registered on Startup India BHASKAR (ID: IN-1126-9577DW)
- BHASKAR public profile: https://www.startupindia.gov.in/bhaskar/profile?bhaskarid=IN-1126-9577DW

## Product: FaculZo
- Three connected campus apps (Student, Staff, Security): attendance, notes, leave requests, gate passes and notices.
